nameplate.description: Contains the nameplate information attached to the product

AddressInformation.description: Note: this set of information is defined by SMT drop-in "Address Information"

CountryOfOrigin.description: Note: Country codes defined accord. to DIN EN ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes

asset_interfaces_description.description: Definition of the Submodel Asset Interfaces Description identified by its semanticId.

interface_mqtt.description: Indicates the entry point for a particular asset interface

title.description: Provides a human-readable title to give a human-readable context of the interface.

EndpointMetadata.description: Provides the metadata of the asset’s endpoint (base, content type that is used for interaction, etc)

base.description: Defines asset connection entry point. Each protocol specifies a base pattern. Please see Annex B.1 of the AID document for more details.

contentType.description: Defines content type based on a media type (e.g., text/plain) and potential character decoding/encoding type (e.g., charset=utf-8) for the media type (see RFC2046) of the whole interface

security.description: Selects one or more of the security scheme(s) that can be applied at runtime from the collection of security schemes defines in securityDefinitions.

securityDefinitions.description: Defines the security scheme according to W3C:

InteractionMetadata.description: Provides the metadata of the actually interfaces such as which datapoints and functions are provided by the properties, actions, and events interaction abstraction.

properties.description: Collection of asset’s datapoint definitions as property SMC

actions.description: Collection of functions that can be done on asset as action SMC

Halt.description: An invokable function of the asset (WoT ActionAffordance).

title.description: Provides a human-readable title to give a human-readable context of the interface.

synchronous.description: The result of the action arrives in the reply to the invocation. Absent: unknown.

required.description: Names of the members of this object that must be present.

type.description: Indicates the abstract data type (one of object, array, string, number, integer, boolean, or null) of the described datapoint

title.description: Provides a human-readable title of this interaction (e.g., display a text for UI representation)

properties.description: Nested definitions of a datapoint. Only applicable if type=object.

Uuid.description: Defines a data element within an object-based datapoint.

key.description: Optional element when the idShort of {property_name} cannot be used to reflect the desired property name due to the idShort restrictions (e.g., payload message uses “temperature-value” as key term).

type.description: Indicates the abstract data type (one of object, array, string, number, integer, boolean, or null) of the described datapoint

forms.description: Contains information about datapoint resource location.

href.description: Target IRI relative path or full IRI of asset’s datapoint. The relative endpoint definition in href is always relative to base defined in EndpointMetadata

mqv_qos.description: Defined the level of guarantee for message delivery between clients.

Endpoints.description: Collection of references to control endpoints supported by the instance of the component

Halt.description: This skill has this native interface in the AID submodel.

Skills.description: Collection of skills offered by the component instance

Halt.description: Contains the basic information to call (request the execution of) a skill, e.g. its signature

Disabled.description: Boolean property that defines if the skill is (currently) disabled, e.g. not licensed, tested, suitable.

Modes.description: Collection of operation, operating, operational or execution modes (depending on the standard), in which the skill is available/allowed to execute.

Parameters.description: Collection of parameters used for the configuration of the skill.

Errors.description: Collection of references to the error codes of the component that may be raised by this skill.

Uses.description: Collection of references to other skills, that this skill uses.

interface_reference.description: Reference to the AID action that natively implements this skill.

operation.description: Operation to invoke this skill (delegated via operation delegation).

Type.description: Reference between the component instance and its respective ControlComponentType Submodel.

capability_description.description: Definition of the Submodel CapabilityDescription identified by its semanticId. The Submodel idShort can be picked freely.

variables.description: An asset's runtime data: time series of its state, measurements and logs.

parameters.description: Hierarchical asset parameter definitions with semantic identifiers.

asset_interfaces_mapping_configuration.description: The AIMC 2.0 is used to describe how data is mapped from asset to AAS or from AAS to AAS.

MappingConfigurations.description: List of MappingConfigurations that each map and transform data from their sources to their sinks.

value.description: A MappingConfiguration defines one logical unit of sources (inputs) and sinks (outputs) that are in relation to one another. The relation can be expressed via a transformation.

DefaultPollingInterval.description: The DefaultPollingInterval defines the default time interval in seconds for fetching new data from the synchronous data sources defined in this MappingConfiguration. It must be greater than zero for synchronous protocols (e.g. HTTP) that need polling and is ignored for asynchronous protocols (e.g. MQTT).

Transformation.description: The transformation allows for transforming incoming data before writing it to the sinks. The transformation must contain an "aimc_main(sources)" entrypoint function in Lua.
Transformation.value: function aimc_main(sources) return { Halt = { Uuid = sources.Uuid } } end

Sources.description: This list includes all data sources that are used in this MappingConfiguration.

value.description: A data source is defined by a Source reference, PollingInterval and SourceId.

Source.description: This holds a reference to the respective SubmodelElement used as data source. A data source can be any SubmodelElement including those defined in the InteractionMetadata of AID Submodels for fetching live-data from assets.

SourceId.description: This is a unique and non-empty identifier that facilitates data access in the Lua transformation or establishes a relationship to a corresponding sink when no transformation is given. It must only be unique with respect to the Sources-list of the parent MappingConfiguration and not globally.

Sinks.description: This list includes all data sinks that are used in this MappingConfiguration.

value.description: A data sink is defined by a Sink reference and SinkId.

Sink.description: This holds a reference to the respective SubmodelElement used as data sink for live-data.

SinkId.description: This is a unique and non-empty identifier that facilitates data writing in the Lua transformation or establishes a relationship to a corresponding source when no transformation is given. It must only be unique with respect to the Sinks-list of the containing MappingConfiguration and not globally.

hierarchical_structures.description: The Submodel HierarchicalStructures identified by its semanticId. The Submodel idShort can be picked freely.

EntryNode.description: Base entry point for the Entity tree in this Submodel, this must be a Self-managed Entity reflecting the Assets administrated in the AAS this Submodel is part of.

planarTableShuttle1AAS.description: Base entry point for the Entity tree in this Submodel, this must be a Self-managed Entity reflecting the Assets administrated in the Asset Administration Shell this Submodel is part of. The idShort of the EntryNode can be picked freely and may reflect a name of the asset.

SameAs.description: Reference between two Entities in the same Submodel or across Submodels.

planarTableShuttle2AAS.description: Base entry point for the Entity tree in this Submodel, this must be a Self-managed Entity reflecting the Assets administrated in the Asset Administration Shell this Submodel is part of. The idShort of the EntryNode can be picked freely and may reflect a name of the asset.

SameAs.description: Reference between two Entities in the same Submodel or across Submodels.

planarTableShuttle3AAS.description: Base entry point for the Entity tree in this Submodel, this must be a Self-managed Entity reflecting the Assets administrated in the Asset Administration Shell this Submodel is part of. The idShort of the EntryNode can be picked freely and may reflect a name of the asset.

SameAs.description: Reference between two Entities in the same Submodel or across Submodels.

HasPart_planarTableShuttle1AAS.description: Modeling of logical connections between components and sub-components. Either this or "IsPartOf" must be used, not both.

HasPart_planarTableShuttle2AAS.description: Modeling of logical connections between components and sub-components. Either this or "IsPartOf" must be used, not both.

HasPart_planarTableShuttle3AAS.description: Modeling of logical connections between components and sub-components. Either this or "IsPartOf" must be used, not both.

ArcheType.description: ArcheType of the Submodel, there are three allowed enumeration entries: 1. “Full”, 2. “OneDown” and 3. “OneUp”.
